Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) aur BP (Blood Pressure) ki dawaon ka ek saath lena **safety** ka matter hai. Is ka sabab yeh hai ki:

1. **Paracetamol** (4-6 mg/kg/day) aur **BP ki dawaon** (jese ki beta-blockers, ACE inhibitors, calcium channel blockers) ka saath lena **liver damage** aur **low blood pressure** ka khatra badha sakta hai.
